text:
kai: Spotted a regression on narrow viewports (~320px): when the sidebar collapses to overlay the table gets a horizontal scroll and the action column wraps, pushing rows taller. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/regression-320-wrap.png
meera: Repro on iPhone SE. Looks like the action menu lacks a min-width so it drops. Also sticky header translation looks jittery when overlay opens.
josh: Two options: reserve an affordance width and keep table layout stable, or replace table with compact stacked rows under 320px. Which direction do we prefer?
kai: Leaning toward reserving width for now to avoid changing power-user density. We can introduce a compact stacked fallback later if needed.
nada: (typo) ada: Small accessibility point: whichever affordance we pick, it must be explicit text for discoverability. Icon-only + tooltip fails in quick tests. Use "View" or "View details" instead of "More".
meera: Hallway test: 10 ppl — "View details" had 70% success, "More" only ~40%. I'll prototype with a 44px pill labeled "View" (keeps width) and full label on tap.
josh: CSS prototype: ```css
@media (max-width: 360px){
  .table-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 44px; gap:8px; contain: layout; }
  .action-trigger{ min-width:44px; text-align:right; }
}
```
kai: Important: when the panel opens trap focus, set role="dialog", and return focus to trigger on close. Add aria-expanded on trigger.
ada: Also ensure mobile hit area >=44px and long-press shows tooltip label. For SR add aria-label="View details for <item>".
meera: There's also the sticky header jump: it seems related to toggling `overflow:hidden` on body when opening overlay. Mobile Safari recalculates viewport and sticky breaks. We should avoid toggling body positioning. Use fixed overlay sibling instead.
josh: Suggested guarded fix: avoid body overflow toggles, render sidebar as fixed sibling with `inert` attribute on underlying content for a11y, and keep footer/sticky elements in higher stacking context.
kai: Feature flag plan: `compact_table_affordance_v1`. Canary behind flag and measure `ui.mobile.table_affordance.opened` and copy variants `View` vs `Details`.
design-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4122 includes mocks, accessibility checklist, and telemetry wiring. QA checklist: iPhone SE Safari, Pixel 3 Chrome, VoiceOver/TalkBack, keyboard-only nav, large fonts, RTL.
ada: One more copy nit: footer CTA truncates on tiny widths. Prefer explicit short copy "New" with aria-label="Create deployment" vs truncating "Create" to "Crea". Test icon+sr-only as alternate.
meera: I'll add both copy variants to the canary and wire telemetry `ui.mobile.footer_create_variant`. Also will add perf markers around sidebar open/close to measure layout shifts.
josh: Good. Once PR is up tag @qa and @design for accessibility pass. Thanks team :thumbsup:
